## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related GitHub issues and/or
local backlog documents. Use “Closes #…” only when this fully resolves that issue.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Include browser, input devices, and
relevant settings for gameplay checks. State what remains untested or needs player
review. For documentation-only changes, describe link and formatting checks.

## Visual evidence

Include comparable before/after images for visible changes, or mark not applicable.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and followed the Code of Conduct.
- [ ] The change is focused, and substantial design changes were discussed first.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check`.
- [ ] Related local issue status and validation records are updated, if applicable.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute this work under the MIT License and have
      identified any third-party material.
- [ ] No credentials, local saves, or browser profiles are included.
